Take notes on which styles, colours, products and ideas you like so it’s easier for us to understand what designs and looks you prefer.
2. Choose the planning service for you
Do you want help with a space or a whole room? A particular furniture system? For your home or business? Browse the furnishing areas below to find the planning service you need.

3. Book an appointment
You can use the related
links below
.
4. What do you need?
Make a list of all your essential needs and wishes to create your dream space.
5. Measure your space

5. Measure your space
We’ll need details about the space or room. Record measurements of height, width and depth as well as positions/dimensions of electrical outlets, doors, windows, etc.

6. Take pictures
A drawing or a photo of the space can be very useful. We’ll discuss layouts and solutions to create a plan and a shopping list.
7. Take time to assess the plan and next steps

7. Take time to assess the plan and next steps
Do you need to make changes? Start over? Are you happy with the final design? When you’re ready, visit us in-store or online to finalise your order.
